transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess... I just haven't been feeling right lately. My eating has been pretty erratic. Some weeks I just... I don't really have an appetite for dinner at all. And then other times, I'll find myself standing in the kitchen late at night, just eating crackers and sweets when everyone else is asleep. It's just... it's been all over the place.

Have you noticed yourself eating a lot more than usual in a short period of time, like a binge, followed by behaviors such as making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or doing extra exercise to try to compensate for it?
No... I don't do anything like that. I don't eat that much at once, it's just a few things. And I definitely don't make myself sick or... whatever else you said. No.
Have these changes in your eating habits caused you a lot of distress or affected your daily life in any way?

I suppose so... a little. I mean, I've just fallen behind on some things lately. Like my facilitator training... and some private blog work I do. It's just gotten really hard to organize my projects and... explain things properly. And... well, things are a bit tense at home right now, so keeping any sort of normal routine with my husband has been difficult.
Have you found yourself losing interest in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies, work, or spending time with loved ones?

I guess so. Um... things I used to look forward to kind of just feel like chores now. I just keep putting them off. Like... cooking, or my book club. Going to galleries... tending the rose beds. I just... I haven't really felt like doing any of it lately.
Have you been feeling down or having a low mood most of the day, nearly every day, lately?
I suppose... yes. There are stretches where... well, the house just feels gray. Heavy. I'll just sit at the kitchen table... feeling empty. Even when nothing bad has happened. It just... sits there.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or worthless, even when there’s no real reason for it?

I don't know about worthless... but, yes, I suppose guilt is there. Um... I'll just sit and replay these tiny things in my head for hours. Like... if I spent a little too much on a new tube of paint, or if I was a bit short with my husband. It just spirals, and... I start to feel like I've somehow ruined everything in the house just by doing that. It's... probably silly.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your sleep lately, like having trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or waking up earlier than usual and not being able to go back to sleep?

I don't know if I'd call it trouble sleeping. I just... haven't needed as much lately. Maybe three or four hours. 

I wake up feeling... well, charged, I guess. I'll just get up before the sun and write a blog post, or... plan out some projects. I don't really feel tired, so... I just get up.
Have you been feeling unusually energetic or hyper lately, like you don’t need as much sleep as usual and have a lot of restless energy to get things done?

I suppose... yes. I just find it hard to sit still when I get like that. 

I end up... well, just keeping busy. I'll clean the shelves, or... rearrange my art supplies. Maybe draft a few poems. And if I run out of things to do inside, I just... pace around out in the garden. It's just... if I try to stop and just sit down, I feel like I might crawl out of my skin. So I just keep moving.
Have you had periods where your mood was unusually high, overly happy, or irritable — not just about one thing, but in a way that felt different from your usual self?

I suppose... yes. There are times when I feel... just very bright. Like I'm unstoppable. 

But then... I don't know, it can change quickly. I'll suddenly get furious over something small. Like... if my husband moves my paints, or if he questions a receipt. I just... get very angry.
Have you had times when you felt unusually high, energetic, or irritable for several days in a row — not just a few hours, but lasting for days at a time?

Yes, I suppose so. It's... it lasts for days, yes. 

I think... well, those stretches where I'm just very energized and doing too much... they've been happening for a while now. Maybe a year and eight months, give or take.

During those times when you felt unusually energetic or high, did you find that you needed much less sleep than usual and still felt rested or full of energy, even if you only slept a couple of hours?

I suppose so, yes. I... I don't need much sleep then. 

Maybe three or four hours. And I'll wake up feeling... charged, I guess. I'll just get up and start writing blog posts, or... planning out projects. Long before the sun is up. I just don't feel tired.
Have there been times when your mood was so high or irritable that it was clearly different from your usual self, and it lasted for at least a whole week without stopping?

I... yes. Like I said before, when I get into those stretches where I feel so bright and unstoppable, or when I get furious at my husband over the paints... it doesn't just pass in a day or two. It can last for a whole week. Yes.
